summary: Keep compiled database upgrades on one entity/module tree and support argument-free shutdown on macOS Bash 3.2.
userImpact: Existing databases can run historical entity-based migrations from a compiled backend.
Developers can stop their local Compose stack with no extra arguments on stock macOS Bash.

instructions: Build or install the corrected backend before upgrading an existing database; retain its data volume.

configuration: Contributor setup documents environment bootstrapping, host database prerequisites, and the current CI commands.
Oracle compiled smoke lets the application bootstrap its pristine disposable database and record the migration ledger; a test-only schema sync no longer creates a latest schema with an empty ledger.

notes: Historical migration bodies and the migration inventory are unchanged. Compiled migrations resolve the entities registered by the same compiled backend.

security: No authentication or authorization policy changes.
documentation: CONTRIBUTING.md describes startup completion, non-destructive upgrades, isolated test database setup, and CI checks.
knownLimitations: Physical database portability and production image acceptance require their candidate gates.
rollback: Restore the prior application; this change adds no migration or schema transition.
validation: Node 24.18.1: complete backend unit suite passed (3781 tests across 466 files); Node 24.10.0: frontend unit suite passed (1562 tests across 316 files).
Workspace typecheck and warning-free lint passed with pnpm 11.0.8.
Both compiled PostgreSQL historical upgrades passed with retained data and repeat-run idempotence; all ten backend/published adapter path selections passed.
Eight actual shutdown argv cases passed under macOS Bash 3.2 with a recording Docker stub.
CI contracts (166 tests), affected classifier contracts (51 tests), documentation boundary, release-note preflight, and package version guard passed.
The initial Node 24.10.0 broad backend run had two HTTP socket/parser failures. All 94 tests in those files passed focused reproduction; the complete suite subsequently passed under Node 24.18.1.

Final adapter discovery correction: 48 focused adapter/portability tests passed, and ten isolated compiled adapter probes discover only timestamped migrations. The earlier hosted matrix failed on the helper module constructor and requires fresh exact-head acceptance.

Hosted d92b3709 passed the full physical five-adapter portability matrix. Its separate Oracle smoke exposed a current-schema/empty-ledger fixture; the fixture correction requires fresh hosted smoke acceptance.
